ocean.note: Ship placements. Only the owner can see their own ships.

target.note: Attack record. Hit and miss pegs placed here by the server after each fire action.

ships_remaining.note: Number of unsunk ships. Starts at 5, decremented when a ship is fully hit.

ship.note: Each ship is a single multi-cell component spanning multiple grid cells. Orientation is specified at placement time. Engine tracks hit_count property; ship is sunk when hit_count equals span.

peg.note: Placed on the attacker target grid by the server after resolving a fire action.

phases.name: placement
phases.ends_when: both players have placed all 5 ships
phases.note: Both players place ships on their own ocean grid. Server validates no overlap and within bounds. Neither player sees the opponent ocean grid.

constraints: ship must be fully within the 10x10 grid
ship segments cannot overlap with existing segments
ship must be horizontal or vertical (no diagonal)
each ship type placed exactly once

fire.constraint: cell not already attacked (no peg on target grid at that position)
fire.server_resolves: check opponent ocean grid at cell; if ship present: hit (increment hit_count, place hit peg on attacker target grid); if empty: miss (place miss peg on attacker target grid)

sunk_detection.definition: Ship sunk detection after each hit
sunk_detection.effect: if hit_count equals ship span, emit sunk event and decrement ships_remaining counter
